This Week at a Glance

  • Concerts, Theatre & Entertainment

  • Suggested Itineraries

Recommended Highlights This Week

1. Sentosa GrillFest (Opens 23 July)

2. EXO PLANET Tour – 24 & 26 July

3. Mitski Live in Singapore – 21 July

4. NDP 2026 Preview 1 – 25 July

5. F1 Exhibition Singapore – Opens 23 July

6. Faster Football Singapore – 24–26 July

7. MENSHO X Ramen – Raffles Place

8. Tiffany & Co. Blue Box Cafe

9. A Magical Island Adventure at Sentosa

10. Seoul & So – New Korean Dining at National Gallery

Overall Summary

Sentosa GrillFest opens on the 23rd and runs into mid-August, giving us a solid new beachfront recommendation. It's also a big week for K-pop, with EXO back in Singapore for the first time since 2019 and Mitski playing The Star Theatre. National Day prep steps up a gear too – the first public Preview is on the 25th, so expect Kallang to get busy. On the food side, MENSHO X has just landed at Raffles Place with its first-ever outlets outside Tokyo, which is worth flagging to anyone who loves ramen.

Events & Festivals

Sentosa GrillFest

Sentosa's beachfront cookout is back for its ninth year, and this time it's bringing 42 food vendors across five zones plus something new – Chef's Grill, an eight-course omakase-style dinner right on the sand.

Event Date: 23 July–16 August 2026 (selected Thu–Sun dates)

Time: 4:00pm–10:30pm

Location: Siloso Beach, Sentosa

Admission: Free entry; food and beverage purchased separately

Best For: Couples / Groups / Food Lovers / Sunset Diners

Concierge Recommendation: We can start recommending this one now that it's open. Tell guests to time their arrival for sunset – that's when it really comes alive. Chef's Grill has limited seats, so get guests to book ahead if they're keen.

F1 Exhibition Singapore

A new motorsport exhibition opens this week, walking visitors through the history and stories behind Formula One. Good timing, too – it's clearly building anticipation ahead of this year's Singapore Grand Prix.

Event Date: 23 July–2 August 2026

Best For: Formula One Fans / Families / Repeat Visitors

Concierge Recommendation: Pair this with the Singapore GP ALL ACCESS 2.0 experience at the F1 Pit Building – makes for a great full day out for any motorsport fan staying with us.

A Magical Island Adventure at Sentosa

Sentosa's Disney Cruise Line takeover is still going strong, with installations spread across Palawan Beach, San Fransokyo Street, Toy Story Place and Marvel Landing – think a six-metre inflatable anchor and a towering Baymax you really can't miss. The Southernmost Point now stays open till 10pm too, lit up as a glowing coastal escape after dark.

Event Date: Until 20 September 2026

Location: Sentosa

Website: https://www.sentosa.com.sg/en/campaigns/magicalislandadventure/

Recommended Duration: Half day

Best For: Families / Disney Fans / Cruise Guests / Sentosa Visitors

Concierge Recommendation: Still one of our go-to family recommendations. If guests can stay into the evening, the Southernmost Point lighting is worth planning the visit around.

CRYBABY at Resorts World Sentosa

Hard to miss these – five-metre inflatable sculptures of an anglerfish, a pufferfish and a whale shark have taken over RWS, alongside a CRYBABY pop-up store near the Coach Singapore boutique.

Event Date: Until 30 August 2026

Location: Resorts World Sentosa

Best For: Families / Young Adults / Collectors / Photography

Concierge Recommendation: Easy add-on for anyone already spending the day at RWS – free, quick, and great for photos.

Istana Open House – National Day

The Istana opened its grounds to the public on Sunday, 26 July, in celebration of National Day, including – for the first time at an Istana Open House – an evening outdoor concert on the lawns.

Event Date: 26 July 2026

Time: 9:30am–8:00pm (last entry 6:45pm)

Location: The Istana, Orchard Road (nearest MRT: Dhoby Ghaut)

Admission: Free for Singaporeans and PRs

Best For: Families / Heritage & Culture / Free Activities

Concierge Recommendation: This was a same-week, date-specific event tied to a public holiday period – worth building a habit of checking for Istana Open House dates each time a national holiday falls within an edition's window, so we don't miss flagging it to guests again.

Attractions & Activities

Faster Football Singapore

A fast-paced 7-a-side football tournament returns this week, bringing in club teams and players from some of the biggest leagues in the world for a condensed, high-energy format.

Event Date: 24–26 July 2026

Best For: Football Fans / Families / Groups

Concierge Recommendation: Good one for guests missing the World Cup buzz once it's over. Tickets may move fast given the timing right after the Final, so check availability early.

Explore Your Canon – Canon PhotoMarathon

Canon's biggest PhotoMarathon yet takes over Urban Park at Guoco Tower this week, with hands-on photography experiences and workshops for everyone from beginners to enthusiasts.

Event Date: 23–25 July 2026

Location: Urban Park @ Guoco Tower

Best For: Photography Enthusiasts / Young Adults

Concierge Recommendation: A nice niche pick for guests who are into photography. Worth checking whether on-site registration is needed before sending anyone down.

Exploria

One of the largest indoor nature-themed multimedia attractions in Southeast Asia, Exploria takes guests through five immersive digital worlds – prehistoric, microscopic, deep-sea and extreme environments.

Location: Mandai Wildlife Reserve

Admission: Ticketed

Website: https://www.mandai.com/en/exploria.html

Recommended Duration: 1.5–3 hours

Best For: Families / Rainy Day / Young Adults / Repeat Visitors

Concierge Recommendation: Great fallback for a rainy afternoon, and works well tacked onto a Bird Paradise or Night Safari visit.

The Portals Experience

A fantasy and sci-fi immersive experience built around original artworks, themed realms, miniatures and interactive displays – the kind of thing that photographs beautifully too.

Event Date: Until 2 September 2026

Time: 9:00am–9:00pm, last entry 8:00pm

Location: Fever Exhibition Hall, 25 Scotts Road

Admission: From S$26 for adults and S$17 for children

Website: https://portals-experience.sg/

Recommended Duration: 60–90 minutes

Best For: Families / Sci-Fi Fans / Fantasy Fans / Rainy Day / Orchard Area Guests

Concierge Recommendation: Handy one to have in your back pocket for guests based near Orchard, especially if it's raining or just too hot to be outside.

Restaurants & Bars

MENSHO X

This is a big one – the celebrated Tokyo ramen brand has opened its first outlets outside Japan, right here in Singapore. Expect inventive flavours, lighter broths and housemade noodles, including seasonal specials like the Mochi Mochi Mazemen and a Toripaitan Tsukemen with yuzu.

Opening: 14 July 2026

Location: 6 Battery Road, #01-02, Singapore 049909

Best For: Ramen Enthusiasts / Business Travellers / Solo Diners

Concierge Recommendation: Great lunch pick for guests staying near Raffles Place. Just warn them it's a global debut, so queues are likely.

Seoul & So

National Gallery Singapore's dining scene keeps growing – Seoul & So is the latest addition, serving hanwoo tasting courses alongside lunch sets and a la carte Korean dishes.

Location: #05-03, National Gallery Singapore, 1 St Andrew's Road

Opening Hours: Daily, 12:00pm–3:00pm & 6:00pm–10:30pm

Best For: Couples / Korean Cuisine Lovers / Civic District Guests

Concierge Recommendation: Easy to combine with a National Gallery visit, and Milli: Sky Dining & Bar is right in the same building if guests want to make a night of two different meals.

Tiffany & Co. Blue Box Cafe

Tiffany's first-ever cafe in Southeast Asia is now open at ION Orchard, with an all-day menu developed alongside Julien Royer of three-Michelin-starred Odette.

Location: ION Orchard

Best For: Couples / Luxury Travellers / Special Occasions

Concierge Recommendation: Still hard to get a table – keep telling guests to book as early as they can.

Milli: Sky Dining & Bar

A rooftop addition to National Gallery Singapore, where Chef LG Han of Michelin-starred Labyrinth teams up with Vijay Mudaliar of Native for a modern spin on Singaporean cuisine and cocktails.

Location: 1 St Andrew's Road, #05-02/#06-01, National Gallery Singapore

Best For: Couples / Business Travellers / Skyline Views

Concierge Recommendation: Suggest arriving around 5pm so guests catch the daylight view before it shifts into the evening skyline – it's a nice moment to plan around.

ATLAS

One of Singapore's most iconic Art Deco bars, tucked inside Parkview Square. The interior alone is worth the trip, and the gin collection here is one of the largest in the world.

Cuisine: Cocktails & European Dining

Location: Parkview Square

Dress Code: Smart Casual

Website: https://atlasbar.sg

Recommended Duration: 1.5–2 hours

Best For: Couples / Business Travellers / Luxury Travellers / Nightlife

Concierge Recommendation: A dependable premium evening pick. Book ahead for Friday and Saturday.

Concerts, Theatre & Entertainment

Mitski Live in Singapore

Acclaimed singer-songwriter Mitski plays Singapore for one night only.

Event Date: 21 July 2026, 8:00pm

Location: The Star Theatre

Best For: Young Adults / Music Fans

Concierge Recommendation: This one's likely to be in high demand, so point guests to secondary ticket platforms if they haven't already got tickets.

EXO PLANET Tour

EXO are back in Singapore for the first time since 2019, playing two nights packed with group hits and solo stages.

Event Date: 24 & 26 July 2026

Location: Singapore Indoor Stadium

Best For: K-pop Fans / Young Adults / Groups

Concierge Recommendation: Tickets are sold out on Ticketmaster, so point guests toward resale platforms if they're keen. Also worth a heads-up: expect heavy crowds and traffic around the Indoor Stadium both nights.

Singapore Symphony Orchestra

The Singapore Symphony Orchestra continues its season with performances at Victoria Concert Hall and the Esplanade.

Website: https://www.sso.org.sg

Recommended Duration: Approximately 2 hours

Best For: Couples / Classical Music Lovers / Luxury Travellers

Concierge Recommendation: A nice pick for guests after something more refined and cultural for the evening.

Hotel & Hospitality News

NoMad Singapore

Hilton's NoMad Singapore is still on track for a late 2026 opening on Orchard Road. The 19-storey hotel will house three dining and bar concepts – NoMad Grill, a New York-style chophouse; The Tropicana Club, a cabaret-inspired cocktail bar; and Sticky Fingers, a soft-serve and cocktail concept – plus a rooftop pool lounge.

Address: 230 Orchard Rd, Singapore 238854

General Manager: Bernardo de la Garza – 18 years in luxury and lifestyle hospitality across Six Senses, Hyatt and Accor; most recently GM at The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon

Director of Culinary: Lorenz Hoja – has cooked across England, France, Austria, the Maldives and Singapore, including over a decade in Joel Robuchon's kitchens

Raffles Sentosa Singapore

Singapore's first all-villa Raffles resort, with private pool villas, destination dining and a strong wellness offering.

Website: https://www.raffles.com/sentosa/

Cluster General Manager: Cavaliere Giovanni Viterale (also overseeing Sofitel Singapore Sentosa Resort & Spa) – 36 years in hospitality, formerly General Manager of The Fullerton Hotels and Resorts

Best For: Luxury Travellers / Honeymooners / Couples

Concierge Recommendation: A great fit for guests wanting an exclusive staycation or a standout dining experience.

Mandai Rainforest Resort by Banyan Tree

A nature-inspired stay right inside Mandai Wildlife Reserve – hard to beat as a base for exploring Singapore Zoo, Bird Paradise and Night Safari.

Website: https://www.mandai.com/en/mandai-rainforest-resort-by-banyan-tree.html

General Manager: Michel Scheffers – over 25 years across luxury and lifestyle hospitality including ONYX Hospitality Group, Shangri-La and Hilton; took over from opening GM Glen Cook

Best For: Families / Nature Lovers / Couples

Concierge Recommendation: A strong pick for anyone planning a two-day wildlife itinerary.

Transport & Operational Updates

Downtown Line Night Works

Downtown Line trains still stop earlier on Friday nights (last train around 11:30pm) and start later on Saturday mornings (from 8:30am). This continues until 5 September while engineering works are finished. Free shuttle buses run in place of trains during these hours.

Concierge Recommendation: If guests are heading out Friday night and relying on the Downtown Line, get them to check last-train timings first, or plan an alternative way home.

Expected Crowds – EXO PLANET Tour

With EXO playing the Indoor Stadium on the 24th and 26th, expect Kallang and the Stadium precinct to get busy both nights – and that's before factoring in any National Day rehearsal activity happening in the same area.

Concierge Recommendation: If guests have evening plans near Kallang on the 24th or 26th, tell them to leave extra time, or take the MRT instead of driving.

Singapore Cruise Centre Redevelopment

HarbourFront Centre is heading into a major redevelopment. While that's underway, ferry departure terminals may shift around, so it's worth double-checking before anyone heads out.

Website: https://www.singaporecruise.com.sg

Best For: Ferry Passengers / Batam & Bintan Travellers

Concierge Recommendation: Always reconfirm the ferry operator, terminal and reporting time before booking transport, and build in at least 60 minutes' buffer before departure.

Changi Airport Travel Advisory

Airport traffic is still running high with the mid-year travel season in full swing. Morning and weekend flights especially will need extra buffer time for check-in, immigration and bag drop.

Website: https://www.changiairport.com

Best For: All Travellers

Concierge Recommendation: Encourage guests to leave earlier than usual during this period, particularly for anything departing before noon.

SimplyGo Public Transport

Visitors don't need a separate transport card – contactless Visa, Mastercard, Amex or NETS cards work straight on the MRT and buses.

Website: https://www.simplygo.com.sg

Best For: First-time Visitors / Families / Budget Travellers

Concierge Recommendation: A simple, convenient option to mention for guests planning several trips around the island in one day.

Looking Ahead

National Day Preparations – Preview 1

NDP 2026 is back at the National Stadium in Kallang for the first time in a decade, so this year's rehearsals and fireworks are all centred on Kallang rather than Marina Bay. Preview 1 lands this week on the 25th, with Preview 2 on 1 August ahead of National Day itself on the 9th.

Event Date: Preview 1 – 25 July 2026

Location: National Stadium, Kallang

Fireworks Timing: Displays begin around 7:30pm, building to a finale around 8:10–8:30pm. Fired from Kallang Basin only – there are no Marina Bay fireworks this year.

Best Free Viewing Spots (no ticket needed):

  • Stadium Riverside Walk – right beside the National Stadium, closest unobstructed view of the Kallang Basin; gets crowded fast

  • Tanjong Rhu Promenade – quieter waterfront alternative across the basin

  • Kallang Riverside Park – open green space, good for guests with a picnic mat

  • Kallang Lawn Bowl – spacious grassy area, comfortable for families

Website: https://www.ndp.gov.sg

Concierge Recommendation: Expect diversions and crowds around Kallang/Stadium Boulevard on the 25th, right on top of the EXO crowds from the night before. If guests don't have a balloted ticket but still want to catch a glimpse, point them toward Stadium Riverside Walk – tell them to get there by 6:45–7:00pm to secure a spot before the crowds build.

NDP 2026 Majulah Hunt

The island-wide digital treasure hunt is still going – participants visit 61 landmarks (“Discoveries”) across Singapore and check in via an in-app camera, with a limited-edition National Day plushie up for grabs after seven Discoveries.

Concierge Recommendation: A fun, free way to get guests exploring beyond the usual tourist spots. Just note that check-ins are capped at seven per week.

Upcoming Attractions & Events

Concierge colleagues should monitor announcements for NDP Preview 2 (1 August), MAMAMOO's concert (31 July), and the continuation of Sentosa GrillFest through mid-August.

Concierge Recommendation: Useful for guests planning a return visit or extending their stay.

Additional Information

Concierge Notes

  • Sentosa GrillFest opens this week – a fresh recommendation for beachfront dining through mid-August.

  • Expect heavy crowds around Kallang on 24, 25 and 26 July due to EXO's concerts and the NDP Preview – plan guest transport accordingly.

  • Weekend reservations are strongly recommended for ATLAS and other premium dining venues.

  • Recommend guests travelling by ferry verify their departure terminal before leaving the hotel.

Suggested Itineraries

Half Day

Sentosa Beach & Grill

A Magical Island Adventure - Sentosa GrillFest dinner - Palawan Beach sunset

Full Day

Civic District & Dining

National Gallery Singapore - Seoul & So lunch - Milli: Sky Dining & Bar - ATLAS nightcap

2 Days

Day 1

Marina Bay Sands - Gardens by the Bay - Singapore Flyer - MENSHO X dinner at Raffles Place

Day 2

Bird Paradise - Singapore Zoo - Mandai Rainforest Resort - Night Safari

3 Days

Day 1: Marina Bay & Civic District

Day 2: Sentosa Island (GrillFest & Magical Island Adventure)

Day 3: Mandai Wildlife Reserve

Quick Reference

Best Family Attraction: A Magical Island Adventure at Sentosa

Best Couple Experience: ATLAS

Best Luxury Dining: Tiffany & Co. Blue Box Cafe

Best New Attraction: Sentosa GrillFest

Best Rainy Day Activity: Exploria

Best Weekend Recommendation: Sentosa GrillFest

Best Wildlife Experience: Mandai Wildlife Reserve

Best New Restaurant: MENSHO X

Prepared by

Rajiv Sharma

Assistant Chef Concierge

Shangri-La Singapore
